This code aimed at loading the data and adding:
1) invader/ non-invader status
2) Add metadata such as habitats
3) Group by assemblages
4) create clean subsets

Library
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

#1) Data wrangling
```{r}
#MaxN data 
obs_data=readxl::read_excel("./data/18097061/med_red_MaxN_data.xlsx",sheet = 1) %>% 
  select(1:11) %>% #based on [https://doi.org/10.12681/mms.41312](https://doi.org/10.12681/mms.41312)
  left_join(read.csv("./data/is_lessepsian.csv"),
            by="species") %>% #add status
  mutate(status = replace_na(status, 0)) %>% #The two remaining native species are fixed to 0
  left_join(readxl::read_excel("./data/18097061/Metadata.xlsx",sheet = 1) %>% 
              select(OpCode,
                     location,
                     lat=lat_y,
                     long=lon_x,
                     seabed_form),
            by="OpCode") %>% #Group data by assemblages
  mutate(
    group=case_when(
      c(sea%in%"red" & status%in%0)~"Natives - Red Sea",
      c(sea%in%"med"& status%in%0)~"Natives - Med. Sea",
      c(sea%in%"red"& status%in%1)~"Lessepsians - Red Sea",
      c(sea%in%"med"& status%in%1)~"Lessepsians - Med. Sea")) %>% 
  mutate(
    group=case_when(
      c(sea%in%"red" & status%in%0 & species%in%"Seriola dumerili")~"Lessepsians - Red Sea",
      c(sea%in%"red" & status%in%0 & species%in%"Echeneis naucrates")~"Lessepsians - Red Sea",
      c(sea%in%"med" & status%in%0 & species%in%"Seriola dumerili")~"Lessepsians - Med. Sea",
      c(sea%in%"med" & status%in%0 & species%in%"Echeneis naucrates")~"Lessepsians - Med. Sea",
      TRUE~group)) %>%#Add species depth range
  mutate(Family=as.factor(Family),
         location=as.factor(location),
         status=as.factor(status),
         group=as.factor(group),
         seabed_form=as.factor(seabed_form),
         sea=as.factor(sea),
         lat=as.numeric(lat),
         long=as.numeric(long),
         spatial_block = as.factor(paste(round(lat, 2), round(long, 2), sep = "_"))) %>% 
  filter(!OpCode%in%c("isrsdot201119B","isrsdot201119A")) %>% 
  ungroup()

obs_data %>% 
  group_by(sea) %>% 
  summarise(deployments=n_distinct(OpCode),
            species=n_distinct(species),
            Total_MaxN=sum(MaxN))
obs_data$species %>% n_distinct()
```

#2) Species-level traits
```{r}
#population level estimates (excluding body size)
species_level_traits = obs_data %>%
  filter(MaxN > 0) %>%
  left_join(readxl::read_excel("./data/18097061/Metadata.xlsx",sheet = 1) %>% 
              select(OpCode,
                     date) %>% 
              mutate(month=lubridate::month(date,label=T)) %>% 
              select(-date),
            by="OpCode") %>%
  group_by(sea,species) %>%
  summarise(
    depth_range = max(depth) - min(depth),
    min_depth=min(depth),
    sbt_range = max(temperature) - min(temperature),
    sbt_min=min(temperature),
    sbt_max=max(temperature),
    n_presence = n_distinct(OpCode),
    .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(across(starts_with("sp_"), ~ifelse(is.infinite(.), NA, .))) %>% 
  left_join(readxl::read_excel("./data/18097061/Data S2.xlsx", sheet = 1) %>% 
              select(species,sea,artificial,corals,gravel,macroalgae,rocks,sand,seagrass,silt,`soft corals`),
            by=c("sea","species")) %>%  # 1. Ensure all habitat columns are numeric
  # Remove any duplicates introduced by the Excel join (due to the HOF estimated)
  distinct(sea, species, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(across(c(artificial, corals, gravel, macroalgae, rocks, sand, seagrass, silt, `soft corals`), as.numeric)) %>%
  # 2. Specific edit for Chromis dimidiata and global NA handling
  mutate(
    # Handle corals specifically
    corals = case_when(
      species == "Chromis dimidiata" ~ 1,
      is.na(corals) ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ corals
    ),
    # Handle all other habitat columns: 0 for Chromis and 0 for any NAs
    across(c(artificial, gravel, macroalgae, rocks, sand, seagrass, silt, `soft corals`),
           ~ case_when(
             species == "Chromis dimidiata" ~ 0,
             is.na(.) ~ 0,
             TRUE ~ .)))
```

#3) Data containing true non-detection.
```{r}
#Expand to Include Zeros (Imputed Absences)
# This accounts for sampling effort and zeros
obs_data_inc_zeros <- obs_data %>%
  # Temporarily treat species as character to prevent Sea-mixing
  mutate(species = as.character(species)) %>%
  group_by(sea) %>%
  complete(species, 
           nesting(OpCode, depth, temperature, location, lat, long, seabed_form, spatial_block), 
           fill = list(MaxN = 0)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  
  #join the Species-Level Traits
  left_join(species_level_traits, by = c("sea", "species")) %>%
  # 4. Final Cleanup for GLMM
  group_by(sea, species) %>%
  # Fill static categories like Family and Status
  fill(Family, status, group, .direction = "downup") %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  # Ensure any lingering FL columns from original data are completely dropped
  select(-contains("FL"))
```

#4) Habitat breadth
```{r}
# 1. Calculate Resource Availability (aj) dynamically
# Instead of hardcoding 124/123, we count distinct OpCodes per sea
resource_prop <- obs_data %>%
  filter(OpCode %in% unique(obs_data$OpCode)) %>%
  group_by(sea) %>%
  mutate(total_deployments = n_distinct(OpCode)) %>% # Total per sea
  group_by(sea, seabed_form) %>%
  summarise(
    n_habitat = n_distinct(OpCode),
    total_deployments = first(total_deployments),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(aj = n_habitat / total_deployments)

# 2. Calculate Species Proportions (pj) and Hurlbert's Index
Hurlbert_Calc <- obs_data %>%  # Sum MaxN per species/group/habitat
  group_by(group, species, seabed_form) %>%
  summarise(Nj = sum(MaxN), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
  
  # Ensure all habitats exist for all species (fill 0 if missing)
  complete(seabed_form = unique(
    readxl::read_excel("./data/18097061/Metadata.xlsx",sheet = 1) %>% 
      filter(!seabed_form%in%"na") %>% 
      distinct(seabed_form) %>% 
      pull), fill = list(Nj = 0)) %>%
  
  # Calculate pj (proportion of individual usage)
  group_by(group, species) %>%
  mutate(
    Y = sum(Nj),          # Total MaxN per species
    pj = Nj / Y           # MaxN per habitat divided by the total MaxN
  ) %>%
  
  # Join availability (aj) based on Group/Sea relationship
  mutate(sea = case_when(
    grepl("Med", group, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "med",
    grepl("Red", group, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "red"
  )) %>%
  left_join(resource_prop %>% select(sea, seabed_form, aj), by = c("sea", "seabed_form")) %>%
  
  # --- THE MATH (Hurlbert's) ---
  # Step 1: Sum of (pj^2 / aj)
  group_by(group,sea, species) %>%
  summarise(
    # Hurlbert's Denominator: Sum(pj^2 / aj) - Intermediate mathematical term. Larger numbers here actually mean lower niche breadth.
    sum_pj2_aj = sum((pj^2) / aj, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # We need the minimum aj observed in that sea for standardization
    min_aj = min(aj), 
    
    # Keep Metadata
    Total_Abundance = first(Y),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  
  # Step 2: Final Metric Calculation
  mutate(
    B_prime = 1 / sum_pj2_aj,                      # Hurlbert's B'
    B_prime_std = (B_prime - min_aj) / (1 - min_aj) # Standardized B'A
  ) %>%
  
  # Rounding for cleanliness
  mutate(across(c(B_prime, B_prime_std), round, 3))

# View Results
head(Hurlbert_Calc)
```

#5) species-level data
```{r}
sp_level_data=obs_data_inc_zeros %>%
  group_by(species,sea) %>%
  summarise(
    status = first(status),
    group=first(group),
    Family = first(Family),
    mean_MaxN = mean(MaxN),
    max_MaxN = max(MaxN),
    n_presence=first(n_presence),
    depth_range = first(depth_range),
    min_depth=first(min_depth),
    sbt_range=first(sbt_range),
    sbt_min=min(sbt_min),
    sbt_max=first(sbt_max),
    corals = first(corals),
    artificial = first(artificial),
    gravel = first(gravel),
    macroalgae = first(macroalgae),
    rocks = first(rocks),
    seagrass = first(seagrass),
    silt = first(silt),
    sand = first(sand),
    soft_corals = first(`soft corals`),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    population=paste(species,sea,sep = "_")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(n_presence>1) %>% 
  left_join(Hurlbert_Calc %>% 
              select(sea,species,B_prime_std),
            by=c("sea","species"))#Add Bstd

sp_level_data %>% summary
#Summarise populations and species
sp_level_data$population %>% n_distinct()
sp_level_data$species%>% n_distinct()
sp_level_data %>% 
  filter(sea%in%"red") %>% 
  group_by(status) %>% 
  summarise(sp=n_distinct(species))
sp_level_data %>% 
  filter(sea%in%"med") %>% 
  group_by(status) %>% 
  summarise(sp=n_distinct(species))
```

Corr matrix
```{r}
library(ggcorrplot)

# 1. Prepare and Clean Data
# Select only numeric continuous variables from  summary 
corr_data <- sp_level_data %>%
  select(
    # Abundance / Range
    max_MaxN,
    n_presence,
    # Environmental / Habitat
    depth_range,
    min_depth,
    sbt_range,
    sbt_min, 
    sbt_max,
    # Substrate %
    corals,
    rocks,
    sand,
    seagrass,
    macroalgae,
    artificial,
    silt,
    B_prime_std
  ) %>%
  # Rename columns for the plot
  rename(
    "Abundance (MaxN)" = max_MaxN,
    "Commonness" = n_presence,
    "Depth Range" = depth_range,
    "Min Depth" = min_depth,
    "SBT Range" = sbt_range,
    "Min SBT" = sbt_min,
    "Max SBT" = sbt_max,
    "Cover: Coral" = corals,
    "Cover: Rock" = rocks,
    "Cover: Sand" = sand,
    "Cover: Seagrass" = seagrass,
    "Cover: Algae" = macroalgae,
    "Cover: Artificial" = artificial,
    "Cover: Silt" = silt,
    "Habitat breadth"=B_prime_std
  ) %>%
  # Remove rows with NA to prevent errors
  na.omit()

# 2. Calculate Correlation Matrix
corr_matrix <- cor(corr_data, method = "pearson")

# 3. Calculate Significance (P-values) to cross out non-significant ones
p_mat <- cor_pmat(corr_data)

# 4. Generate the Plot
corr_plot <- ggcorrplot(
  corr_matrix,
  method = "square",        
  type = "lower",           
  hc.order = TRUE,         
  lab = TRUE,               
  lab_size = 2.5,           
  tl.col = "black",         
  tl.srt = 45,              
  colors = c("#6D9EC1", "white", "#E46726"), 
  outline.col = "white",
  ggtheme = ggplot2::theme_classic(),
  tl.cex = 8
)
corr_plot
# Save high-res version
#ggsave("./plots/pearson_matrix.png", corr_plot, width = 15, height = 15, units = "cm", dpi = 300)
```

Write data
```{r}
#observed
write.csv(obs_data,"./data/analysis_data.csv",row.names = F)
#Observed plus absences
write.csv(obs_data_inc_zeros,"./data/obs_data_inc_zeros.csv",row.names = F)
#Species level data
write.csv(sp_level_data,"./data/sp_level_data.csv",row.names = F)
```

#6) Plot variables
```{r}
library(Hmisc) 

# 1. Define custom colors
custom_colors <- c("Natives - Red Sea"      = "#007989", 
                   "Lessepsians - Red Sea"  = "#D9643E", 
                   "Natives - Med. Sea"     = "#073956", 
                   "Lessepsians - Med. Sea" = "#F8B954")

# 2. Prepare the data (body size removed)
plot_data <- sp_level_data %>%
  select(
    group, 
    mean_MaxN, 
    n_presence, 
    depth_range, 
    min_depth, 
    sbt_range, 
    B_prime_std, 
    corals, 
    rocks, 
    sand, 
    seagrass, 
    macroalgae, 
    silt,
    artificial
  ) %>%
  # Pivot all columns except 'group' into 'trait' and 'value' columns
  pivot_longer(cols = -group, names_to = "trait", values_to = "value") %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  # Clean up trait names
  mutate(trait = case_when(
    trait == "mean_MaxN" ~ "Abundance (MaxN)",
    trait == "n_presence" ~ "Commonness",
    trait == "depth_range" ~ "Depth Range",
    trait == "min_depth" ~ "Min. Depth",
    trait == "sbt_range" ~ "Thermal (SBT) Range",
    trait == "B_prime_std" ~ "Habitat Breadth",
    trait == "corals" ~ "Coral Affinity",
    trait == "rocks" ~ "Rock Affinity",
    trait == "sand" ~ "Sand Affinity",
    trait == "seagrass" ~ "Seagrass Affinity",
    trait == "macroalgae" ~ "Algae Affinity",
    trait == "silt" ~ "Silt Affinity",
    trait == "artificial" ~ "Artificial Affinity",
    TRUE ~ trait
  ))

#Lock trait order (excluding body size)
trait_order <- c(
  "Abundance (MaxN)",
  "Commonness",
  "Depth Range",
  "Min. Depth",
  "Thermal (SBT) Range",
  "Habitat Breadth",
  "Coral Affinity",
  "Rock Affinity",
  "Sand Affinity",
  "Silt Affinity",
  "Seagrass Affinity",
  "Algae Affinity",
  "Artificial Affinity"
)
plot_data$trait <- factor(plot_data$trait, levels = trait_order)

# Lock in the factor levels so the order is consistent across all panels
plot_data$group <- factor(plot_data$group, levels = c(
  "Natives - Red Sea",
  "Lessepsians - Red Sea",
  "Lessepsians - Med. Sea",
  "Natives - Med. Sea"
))

# 3. Build the Plot
supp_plot <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = group, y = value)) +
  
  # Layer 1: Grey jittered points for the raw data 
  geom_jitter(color = "grey50", alpha = 0.4, width = 0.15, size = 1.2) +
  
  # Layer 2: Mean and 95% Confidence Interval (colored by group)
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = "mean_cl_normal", 
    geom = "pointrange", 
    aes(color = group), 
    size = 0.8,         
    linewidth = 1       
  ) +
  
  # Apply custom colors
  scale_color_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  
  # Create a separate panel for each trait with independent y-axes
  facet_wrap(~trait, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  
  # Theming for a clean, publication-ready layout
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    # Remove x-axis text to avoid clutter; the legend will explain the groups
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    
    # Style the facet headers
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    
    # Legend formatting
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    
    # Slight margin adjustments
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines")
  ) +
  ylab("Trait Value")

# Print the plot
print(supp_plot)
```
